response.sql: SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE CAST(a.date AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1994-06-17' AND '1996-09-02' GROUP BY d.A3

assumptions.assumption: Both bounds are inclusive (BETWEEN), and account.date is stored as an ISO-style 'YYYY-MM-DD' string, so text comparison with the given bounds works as requested.
An inner join to district drops accounts whose district is missing, as the request specifies. Regions with no matching accounts do not appear in the output.
